name: Cranbe Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CRANBE CAPSULE

Cranbe Capsule is a dietary supplement which is used along with an antibiotic for the management of Urinary tract infections (UTI). It manages recurrent urinary tract infections, catheter-associated UTI, manages and manages UTI during pregnancy and lactation. It contains Cranberry Powder as a key ingredient.

Cranberry manages the urinary tract infection (UTI)-causing bacteria from sticking on the walls of the bladder. Thus, helps to reduce bladder and other urinary tract infections.

Always take Cranbe Capsule as advised by your physician. Swallow the capsule with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the capsule. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose as advised by your physician. It should be used with caution in patients having kidney stones.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of CRANBE CAPSULE

Cranbe Capsule may cause severe allergic reactions like rash or hives, itching, breathing difficulties, chest tightness, swelling of face, mouth, lips, or tongue in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking Cranbe Capsule.

name: Urofit Oral Solution 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About UROFIT SYRUP

Urofit Oral Solution is a nutritional supplement used in the management of kidney stones and renal tubular acidosis. It contains potassium citrate, magnesium citrate and vitamin B6 as active ingredients.

Potassium citrate is a urinary alkaliser and helps to make urine less acidic and manages the formation of kidney stones. Magnesium citrate inhibits the stone formation. Pyridoxine decreases substance that cause kidney stones (oxalate) in urine thus manages formation of kidney stones.

Always take Urofit Oral Solution exactly as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Dilute three teaspoonfuls (15ml) of Urofit Oral Solution with one glass of water and drink after meals or at bed time or as directed by the physician. It is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease with oliguria or azotemia, unmanageed addison’s disease, adynamia episodica hereditaria, acute dehydration, heat cramps, anuria, severe myocardial damage and increased potassium levels.

name: Prostowin Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PROSTOWIN CAPSULE

Prostowin Capsule is a safe and natural alternative to avoid surgical interventions in Benign Prostate Hyperplasia (BPH). It mainly contains Lajjalu (Mimosa pudica), Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris), Kramuka (Areca catechu) and Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus). It successfully relieves the troublesome signs and symptoms of BPH. It is an effective tonic for general and nervine debility, an aphrodisiac and a rejuvenator.  

Lajjalu is an anti-inflammatory, detoxifying, hemostatic and vasoconstrictor that promotes wound healing. It is also useful in prameha and seminal disorders. Gokshura is an analgesic, diuretic, aphrodisiac and nervine tonic that contains Beta-sitosterol, which inhibits the conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone which is an androgen by inhibiting 5 alpha reductases. Kramuka is also a hemostatic and astringent that is useful in spermatorrhoa and polyuria. It has got dual action of being 5 alpha-reductase inhibitors and alpha-adrenergic blockers. Shatavari is an immunomodulator that acts on the prostate.  

Always take Prostowin Capsule as advised by your doctor. Dosage is adjusted based on the age group. Do not exceed the daily recommended dose. Do not take Prostowin Capsule if you are allergic to any of its components. While taking this medicine your doctor may monitor your prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels periodically and discontinue the use if found to be elevated.

Introduction About CRANTOP TABLET

Crantop Tablet is a non-antimicrobial agent which helps in promoting urinary tract health and may help in reducing the frequency of urinary tract infection. It contains Cranberry and D-Mannose as active ingredients which inhibit the causative bacteria to affect the urinary tract.

Cranberry extract and D-mannose manages the urinary tract infection (UTI) by binding to the fimbria (tiny hair like projections) of the E. coli bacteria which is the major cause for UTI. Thereby it manages the attachment of the bacteria to the surface of urinary tract.

Always take Crantop Tablet as advised by your physician. Take one tablet thrice daily after meals. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a sip of water and do not crush or chew. It is not recommended for use in patients having renal impairment and should be used with caution in patients having kidney stones and diabetes.
sideEffectsDetails:

Crantop Tablet may cause mild gastrointestinal problems like nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, and gastric or acid reflux. Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while taking these tablets.

introduction:
Introduction About STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION

STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION is a combination of Potassium citrate and Magnesium citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary alkalizers and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used in the management of renal tubular acidosis with calcium stones and kidney stones (hypocitraturic calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis and uric acid lithiasis with or without calcium stones).

Renal tubular acidosis is a condition in which the kidneys do not remove acids from the blood into the urine as they usually should. Before taking STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests and ECG to understand your existing condition.

STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with hyperkalemia (high potassium levels in the blood), gastrointestinal disease, peptic ulcer disease, urinary tract infection and kidney disease.

STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless it is clearly advised by the doctor. Safety and effectiveness of STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION in children has not been established yet. The most common side effects of taking STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION are abdominal discomfort, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.

mechanismOfAction:
How STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION Works

STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION works by reducing the kidney stone formation. Potassium citrate and magnesium citrate, causes the metabolism of absorbed citrate producing an alkaline load. In addition to raising urinary pH and citrate, this also increases urinary potassium and magnesium. In certain patients, potassium citrate causes a transient reduction in urinary calcium. These changes produce urine that is less helpful to the crystallization of stone-forming salts.

Take STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Use a measuring cup or spoon to properly measure a dose. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Severe abdominal pain, vomiting or gastrointestinal bleeding

STON 1 ORAL SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe myocardial damage or heart failure because it impairs the excretion of potassium. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Have cause for arrest or delay in passage through the gastrointestinal tract (such as those suffering from delayed gastric emptying, esophageal compression, intestinal obstruction or stricture)
Have peptic ulcer disease
Have urinary tract infection

name: CITROLITE Syrup 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About CITROLITE SYRUP

CITROLITE SYRUP contains Disodium Hydrogen Citrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Urinary Alkalizers. It is used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infections (such as low urine output, painful urination or burning sensation while passing urine) when used in combination with antibiotics.

It works by increasing your blood pH and by making your urine less acidic. Therefore, it helps in managing metabolic acidosis (low pH in blood) and hyperuricemia (high blood uric acid levels) and manage the incidence of gout and/or kidney stones caused due to high blood uric acid levels.

It corrects dehydration by replacing the lost electrolytes in the body. It also helps in managing the symptoms of inflammation in the urinary tract such as pyelitis, cystitis, urethritis and urolithiasis. CITROLITE SYRUP must be dissolved in water before consumption.

Before taking CITROLITE SYRUP inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have Addison’s disease, fluid retention in your body parts or lungs, hypertension or heat cramps as a precaution.

Do not take CITROLITE SYRUP without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CITROLITE SYRUP are increased urination, diarrhea and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects troubles you.

How CITROLITE SYRUP Works

CITROLITE SYRUP is a urinary alkalizer. It works by increasing the pH of the blood and urine. This makes your urine less acidic which helps in managing the urinary symptoms (such as painful urination, low urine output or burning sensation while passing urine) caused due to urinary tract infections or inflammation.

It also replenishes the lost electrolytes in the body and increases urine output which helps in managing dehydration and in flushing out harmful bacteria that causes urinary tract infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CITROLITE SYRUP

Take CITROLITE SYRUP as advised by your physician. Dissolve the required amount of the medicine in water before consumption. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, amount of water to be used for dissolution and duration of therapy based on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CITROLITE SYRUP without consulting your doctor.

warnings.details: The safety and effectiveness of CITROLITE SYRUP have not been established in pregnant women. Therefore, it should be used in pregnant women only if considered necessary by the physician. It is strictly not recommended for use in pregnant women with toxaemia (high blood pressure during pregnancy due to infections).
The safety and effectiveness of CITROLITE SYRUP have not been established in breastfeeding women. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.
CITROLITE SYRUP is unlikely to affect your ability for driving or handling any heavy tools or machines.

CITROLITE SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems (such as oliguria, azotemia or anuria). It should be used with caution in patients with low urine output. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CITROLITE SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with acute liver failure. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CITROLITE SYRUP if you are allergic to Disodium hydrogen citrate.
CITROLITE SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with fluid accumulation in the lungs. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CITROLITE SYRUP is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as myocardial damage). It should be used with caution in patients with heart failure or hypertension. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
CITROLITE SYRUP should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.
CITROLITE SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CITROLITE SYRUP is not recommended for use if you:

Have Addison’s disease (a disease caused due to problems in adrenal gland)
Have acute dehydration or heat cramps

Before taking CITROLITE SYRUP inform your doctor if you:

Have fluid retention in your body

Introduction About STONEX CAPSULE

Stonex Capsule is a unique herbal formulation used to offer a single solution for different types of renal calculi, other urinary tract calculi, and urinary disorders. It mainly contains Kramuka Kshara, Gokshura Kshara, Pashanabeda, and Shatavari which help dissolve kidney stones and expel the gravel through urine.

Pashanabeda acts as a strong antilithiatic or anti calcification agent. Kramuka is an antimicrobial agent that controls the symptoms of urinary tract infections. Gokshura significantly increases oxalate excretion in the urine, thus it helps in the excretion of already present urinary tract stones and manages further calculus formation.

Shatavari reduces the elevated level of calcium, oxalate, and phosphate ions in urine which are responsible for calculus formation and increases the magnesium concentration in the urine which is considered to show a significant inhibitory effect on stone formation.

Take Stonex Capsule as advised by your doctor. Swallow with water; do not crush or chew it. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Consult your physician if you experience any allergic reactions after taking it.

Potavac Oral Solution Sugar Free Cherry Flavour is a mineral preparation used to manage low blood potassium levels. It contains Potassium chloride as an active ingredient to improve the levels of potassium in the blood.

Potassium chloride helps to increase the potassium content in the body. Almost all the potassium exists within cells, particularly skeletal muscle cells in the body. This intracellular predominance helps in establishing tonicity, homeostasis, and membrane potential dynamics. In heart muscle cells and nerve cells, potassium plays a vital role in their functioning.

introduction:
Introduction About K MAC UTI SUGAR FREE ORAL SUSPENSION

K MAC UTI SUGAR FREE Oral Suspension is a health supplement used to manage the symptoms of urinary tract infection. It contains Cranberry extract, D-Mannose and Potassium Magnesium Citrate as active ingredients.

Both Cranberry and D-Mannose enables the flushing of bacteria from the urinary tract that causes infection. They work by managing the bacteria from sticking to the walls of the bladder and ureters. Potassium Magnesium citrate makes the urine less acidic which therefore reduces irritation or burning sensation while passing urine. Collectively, they help in management of signs associated with urinary tract infection such as painful urination, burning sensation while passing urine, scanty urine, etc.

Take K MAC UTI SUGAR FREE Oral Suspension as advised by your physician. Your doctor may advise you to dilute the medicine in a glass of water before consumption. Along with K MAC UTI SUGAR FREE Oral Suspension, your doctor may ask you to drink plenty of fluids to help flush out the bacteria quickly, which in turn leads to a fast recovery.
author: Srilekha. R

introduction:
Introduction About CRANTOP SYRUP

CRANTOP Syrup is a dietary supplement used to manage urinary tract infections, kidney stones, burning during urination in adults. It contains Cranberry, D-Mannose, and Potassium magnesium citrate as active ingredients.

Cranberry extract and D- Mannose helps to manages the sticking of bacteria onto the walls of the bladder and helps to manage or manage urinary tract infection effectively. Potassium magnesium citrate is a urinary alkaliser and helps to make urine alkaline and manages the formation of kidney stones.

Take CRANTOP Syrup as advised by the doctor. Shake well before use. Dissolve 15ml in a glass of water and consume. Not to take more than the advised daily usage.
author: Dr. N. Sai Swaroop
